given: the set of stock rows present before the migration
then: every pre-existing stock row still exists afterward with the same count, and each row's sku, location, and quantity are unchanged, with no silent data loss or corruption

independence.rationale: AC2 and AC3 assert what the new columns hold; this asserts that no existing row or its canonical fields are lost or altered by the migration — independently breakable, since a backfill could populate columns correctly yet still drop or mutate rows.

architectural_notes: Infra: a data-durability contract verified by comparing stock row count and each row's canonical sku/location/quantity before vs. after the migration on the paired Lakebase branch. Realized as a property of the additive Alembic migration (infrastructure): ALTER-and-backfill in a single transaction (PI: transactional atomicity) so an aborted run cannot half-apply, with an in-place UPDATE that never DELETEs or rewrites canonical fields. Cross-cutting concern: no silent data loss or corruption (R1) — the highest-priority guarantee of this feature, owned by the migration transaction.
